summaryEn: Musk's opening monologue hosting SNL, joking about his speaking style and Dogecoin and publicly disclosing having Asperger's.
summaryZh: 马斯克主持《周六夜现场》的开场独白，其中拿自己的说话方式和狗狗币开玩笑，并公开透露自己患有阿斯伯格综合征。

segments.textEn: Ladies and gentlemen, Elon Musk.
segments.textZh: 女士们，先生们，有请埃隆·马斯克。

segments.textEn: Thank you, thank you. Thank you very much. It's an honor to be hosting Saturday Night Live. I mean that. Sometimes after I say something, I have to say I mean that so people really know that I mean it. That's because I don't always have a lot of intonation or variation in how I speak, which I'm told makes for great comedy.
segments.textZh: 谢谢，谢谢。非常感谢。能够主持《周六夜现场》，我深感荣幸。我是认真的。有时候我说完一件事后，必须再说一句我是认真的，这样大家才真的知道我是认真的。这是因为我说话时并不总是有很多语调或变化，据说这非常适合喜剧。

segments.textEn: I'm actually making History night as the first person with Asperger's to host snl, Or at least the first to admit it. So I won't make a lot of eye contact with the cast tonight, but don't worry, I'm pretty good at running human in emulation mode.
segments.textZh: 实际上，作为第1个主持《周六夜现场》的阿斯伯格综合征患者，我正在创造“历史之夜”，或者至少是第1个承认这件事的人。所以今晚我不会和演职人员有太多眼神接触，但别担心，我很擅长以模拟模式运行人类。

segments.textEn: I'd first like to share with you my vision for the future. I believe in a renewable energy future. I believe that humanity must become a multi planetary space faring civilization. Those seem like exciting goals, don't they?
segments.textZh: 首先，我想和大家分享我对未来的愿景。我相信一个使用可再生能源的未来。我相信人类必须成为一个多行星航天文明。这些目标听起来很令人兴奋，不是吗？

segments.textEn: Now, I think if I just posted that on Twitter, I'd be fine.
segments.textZh: 现在，我想如果我只是把那段话发到 Twitter 上，应该不会有事。

segments.textEn: But I also write things like 69 days after 4:20 again. Ha ha.
segments.textZh: 但我也会写些像“4:20 之后 69 天，又来了”这种东西。哈哈。

segments.textEn: I don't know. I thought it was funny. That's why I wrote haha at the end.
segments.textZh: 我不知道。我觉得这很好笑。所以我才在末尾写了“哈哈”。

segments.textEn: Look, I know I sometimes say or post strange things, but that's just how my brain works. To anyone I've offended, I just want to say I reinvented electric cars and I'm sending people to Mars in a rocket ship.
segments.textZh: 听着，我知道自己有时会说或发布一些奇怪的东西，但我的大脑就是这样运作的。对于任何被我冒犯过的人，我只想说，我重新发明了电动汽车，而且正在用火箭飞船把人送往火星。

segments.textEn: Did you think I was also going to be a chill, normal dude?
segments.textZh: 难道你们还以为我会是个淡定、正常的家伙吗？

segments.textEn: Now a lot of times people are reduced to the dumbest thing they ever did. Like one time I smoked weed on Joe Rogan's podcast. And now all the time I hear Elon Musk. All he ever does is smoke weed on podcasts. Like I go from podcast to podcast lighting up joints. It happened once. It's like reducing O.J. simpson to murderer.
segments.textZh: 很多时候，人们会被简化为他们做过的最蠢的一件事。比如有一次，我在乔·罗根的播客上抽了大麻。现在我总是听到别人说，埃隆·马斯克。他就只会在播客上抽大麻。说得好像我从一个播客跑到另一个播客，不停地点大麻烟卷。那只发生过一次。这就像把 O.J. 辛普森简化成杀人犯一样。

segments.textEn: That was one time.
segments.textZh: 那只有一次。

segments.textEn: Fun fact. OJ also hosted this show in 79 and again in 96. Killed both times.
segments.textZh: 有趣的事实。OJ 还在 79 年主持过这个节目，并于 96 年再次主持。两次都大获成功。

segments.textEn: One reason I've always loved SNL is because it's genuinely live. A lot of people don't realize that we're actually live right now. Which means I could say something truly shocking like I drive a Prius.
segments.textZh: 我一直喜欢《周六夜现场》的一个原因，是它确实是直播。很多人没有意识到，我们现在真的正在直播。这意味着我可以说一些真正令人震惊的话，比如我开普锐斯。

segments.textEn: SLL is also a great way to learn something new about the host. For example, this is my son's name.
segments.textZh: SLL 也是了解主持人新鲜一面的绝佳方式。例如，这是我儿子的名字。

segments.textEn: It's pronounced cat running across keyboard.
segments.textZh: 它的发音是“猫从键盘上跑过去”。

segments.textEn: Another thing people want to know is, what was that like as a kid? The answer is pretty much the same as now, but smaller.
segments.textZh: 人们还想知道另一件事：小时候是什么样的？答案是和现在差不多，只是更小。

segments.textEn: But we can also ask my mother who's here tonight.
segments.textZh: 不过我们也可以问问今晚来到现场的我母亲。

segments.textEn: Her name is May. Like the month, but with an e at the end.
segments.textZh: 她的名字是 May。就像月份那个词，只不过末尾加了一个 e。

segments.textEn: Thanks for spelling my name, Elon.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你拼出我的名字，埃隆。

segments.textEn: Mom, do you remember when I was 12 and I created my own video game called Blastar about a spaceship that battles aliens?
segments.textZh: 妈妈，你还记得我 12 岁时创作了自己的电子游戏吗？它叫《Blastar》，讲的是一艘与外星人作战的宇宙飞船。

segments.textEn: I do. I remember. They paid you $500, but you were too young to open a bank account, so I had to open one for you.
segments.textZh: 记得。我记得。他们付了你 500 美元，但你年纪太小，不能开银行账户，所以我不得不替你开一个。

segments.textEn: That's right. Whatever happened to that bank account?
segments.textZh: 没错。那个银行账户后来怎么样了？

segments.textEn: That's not important.
segments.textZh: 那不重要。

segments.textEn: You turned that video game about space into reality.
segments.textZh: 你把那个关于太空的电子游戏变成了现实。

segments.textEn: Unless you consider that our reality might be a video game and we're all just computer simulations being played by a teenager in another plan.
segments.textZh: 除非你认为我们的现实可能就是一款电子游戏，而我们全都只是由另一个计划中的某个青少年操控的计算机模拟。

segments.textEn: That's great, Elon.
segments.textZh: 太棒了，埃隆。

segments.textEn: Well, break a leg tonight. I love you very much.
segments.textZh: 好了，祝你今晚演出成功。我非常爱你。

segments.textEn: I love you, too, Mom.
segments.textZh: 我也爱你，妈妈。

segments.textEn: And I'm excited for my Mother's Day gift. I just hope it's not dogecoin.
segments.textZh: 我很期待我的母亲节礼物。只希望不是狗狗币。

segments.textEn: It is.
segments.textZh: 就是。

segments.textEn: Sure is.
segments.textZh: 当然是。

segments.textEn: We've got a. Okay, we've got a great show for you tonight. Miley Cyrus is here, So stick around. We'll be right back.
segments.textZh: 我们准备了一个。好吧，今晚我们为大家准备了一场精彩的节目。麦莉·赛勒斯也来到了现场，所以请继续收看。我们马上回来。
